Entries.StrawberryMilkMafia.SpecialCows_MarnieTe: Hello @,^^I've been meaning to write ever since I heard what you've been up to with your cows. I know it sounds strange, but these teas are real — and perfectly safe when used on adult animals.^^I found the recipes in an old journal that came with some livestock records years ago. There are three: one to bring out the strawberry, one for the chocolate, and one to reverse it if you ever change your mind. I figure they belong with someone who'll actually use them.^^Take good care of those girls!^^  — Marnie^ %item craftingRecipe {{ModId}}_StrawberryTransformationTea %%^ %item craftingRecipe {{ModId}}_ChocolateTransformationTea %%^ %item craftingRecipe {{ModId}}_ReversalTea %%[#]^A letter from Marnie containing three recipes.
Entries.StrawberryMilkMafia.SpecialCows_Demetriu: Dear @,^^I'll be transparent: I noticed some anomalous spectral readings near your barn while calibrating my weather equipment. Once Robin mentioned the livestock situation, I requested a small milk sample for compositional analysis. I hope that's all right.^^The chromatic proteins are unlike anything in the standard dairy literature. Thermo-reversible gel behavior. Exceptional emulsification index. The crystalline structure during freezing is, frankly, remarkable.^^The culinary implications demanded investigation. I've developed three recipes. The ice cream results are particularly compelling — I may have consumed more than the experimental protocol strictly required. For data integrity reasons.^^I look forward to comparing notes.^^  — Demetrius^ %item cookingRecipe {{ModId}}_StrawberryIceCream %%^ %item cookingRecipe {{ModId}}_ChocolateIceCream %%^ %item cookingRecipe {{ModId}}_HotChocolate %%[#]^Research notes from Demetrius.
